equivalence_note: No single treasury and no daily cash statement. Aggregate central government deposits at the Eurosystem (weekly WFS) are the TGA analog (small: 89bn, most governments hold cash outside the Eurosystem); Δ = drain/injection into excess liquidity. Issuance from the four big DMOs is the supply-side view; TARGET balances (monthly) measure fragmentation. Weighted low by construction.

govt_deposits.label: Central government deposits at the Eurosystem (WFS)

govt_debt_held.label: General government debt denominated in euro (WFS asset)

fr_it_es_eu_issuance.label: AFT / MEF / Tesoro ES / EU auction results

ea_deficit_gdp.label: Euro area government deficit(−)/surplus(+), % of GDP (GFS, quarterly)

ea_primary_deficit_gdp.label: Euro area primary deficit(−)/surplus(+), % of GDP

de_auction_volume.label: Bund/Bubill issuance volume per auction date (Finanzagentur)

other_ea_liabilities.label: Liabilities to other euro area residents in euro (WFS L5 = government deposits + other) — long history context
other_ea_liabilities.equivalence_note: the government-deposit breakdown L050100 exists on the portal only since 2025-W45 (verified 2026-09-09); L050000 since 2015 gives the long-run scale (181,821 on 2026-W36 = 89,275 + 92,546)

govt_deposits_wow.label: Δ w/w central government deposits at the Eurosystem (+ = drain from excess liquidity)

fiscal_impulse_4w.label: Fiscal impulse 4w = −Δ4 weeks of government deposits (+ = cash released into excess liquidity)

fiscal_impulse_13w.label: Fiscal impulse 13w = −Δ13 weeks of government deposits (+ = cash released into excess liquidity)

target_fragmentation.label: TARGET fragmentation: Δ 3m of |IT| + |ES| + |FR| liabilities (+ = periphery losing reserves to the core)

fiscal_stance_structural.label: Euro-area general government balance (% GDP, GFS quarterly) — structural stance

fiscal_regime.label: Fiscal regime (weekly rule: impulse 4w ≥ p80 INJECTION · ≤ p20 DRAIN · else NEUTRAL)
